commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+5' Denis Suarez (Alaves) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and David Soria makes a comfortable save.
90+3' Angel Perez (Alaves) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
90+1' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Kiko Femenia is replaced by Diego Rico (Getafe).
90+1' Here comes a substitution. Martin Satriano is given a rest as he is replaced by Allan Nyom (Getafe).
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Referee Juan Martinez halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Jose Bordalas Jimenez, then shows him a yellow.
87' Adrian Liso (Getafe) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
85' Facundo Garces (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Martinez had an easy-decision to make.

84' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
83' Yusi (Alaves) makes a strong challenge and Juan Martinez blows for a foul. Getafe are awarded the free kick.
81' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
81' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Alaves.

80' Aitor Manas (Alaves) reacted quickly inside the box and got on the end of the resulting corner. He slammed the ball towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper pulled off an astonishing save to deny him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Alaves.
80' Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
79' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Alaves.
77' Eduardo Coudet has decided to substitute Jonny Otto and he is replaced by Yusi (Alaves).
77' The game has come to an end for Carles Alena. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Angel Perez (Alaves).
75' Juan Martinez shows a yellow card to Abdel Abqar (Getafe) for his blatant foul.
73' The attendance is 15960.
72' 0 - 2 Goal! Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) lashes the penalty into the right side of the goal, giving the keeper no chance.
71' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
70' Jon Pacheco (Alaves) jumps into a tackle and Juan Martinez signals a foul. Getafe are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
67' We are about to witness a subsitution. Adrian Liso (Getafe) for Luis Vazquez.
66' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
64' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The linesman signals a throw-in for Getafe.

63' Abdel Abqar (Getafe) is quickest inside the box and jumps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
62' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Getafe.

62' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball goes out of play. Getafe are awarded a corner kick.
60' Jonny Otto (Alaves) has tested the patience of referee Juan Martinez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
59' Substitution. Aitor Manas (Alaves) replaces Toni Martinez.
59' Eduardo Coudet decides to make a substitution. Pablo Ibanez will be replaced by Denis Suarez (Alaves).
58' Calebe goes off the pitch and Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) comes on.
58' The free kick from long range, taken by Alaves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
57' Abdel Abqar (Getafe) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

53' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Luis Milla, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Luis Vazquez (Getafe), who beats Antonio Sivera with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
51' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Domingos Duarte (Getafe) was quite harsh and Juan Martinez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' Juan Martinez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) commits a rough challenge and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.

45' What a chance that is! Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
43' Alaves are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
41' Luis Vazquez (Getafe) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the right post. What a poor effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
41' Corner kick. Getafe will have an opportunity.

39' Lucas Boye (Alaves) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
39' Alaves will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
36' CHANCE! Toni Martinez (Alaves) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
34' Mario Martin (Getafe) is being substituted because of an injury. Jose Bordalas Jimenez sends Abdel Abqar on the pitch.
33' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

32' Jon Pacheco (Alaves) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper leaps from the ground and makes a stunning save. The linesman makes the right call and Alaves will have a corner.
32' Alaves force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
30' Toni Martinez (Alaves) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but David Soria is alert and denies him.
28' Lucas Boye (Alaves) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
27' Mario Martin (Getafe) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
27' Mario Martin (Getafe) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
24' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) commits a rough foul. Juan Martinez stops the game and makes a call.
23' Carles Alena (Alaves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
21' The Alaves players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
19' Rough tackle by Lucas Boye (Alaves). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Getafe produce a short pass from the free kick.
16' Juan Martinez blows his whistle. Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) commits a foul after dangerous play. Getafe win a free kick.
13' Martin Satriano (Getafe) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
11' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.
10' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Alaves, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Alaves are awarded a corner kick.
9' Djene (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Martinez had an easy-decision to make.

8' The ball rebounds out to Mario Martin (Getafe) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
8' The resulting set piece from Getafe is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

7' A great solo run by Martin Satriano (Getafe) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the bottom left corner was easily caught by Antonio Sivera. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
5' Alaves enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
2' A great run from Lucas Boye (Alaves) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
